units: <cite ref="Pesachim 74b:4">Pes. 74ᵇ</cite> <he>טַפְלֵיה ההוא וכ׳</he> put a dough paste over a pigeon.
M. Kat. 9ᵇ טַפְלָהּ אבר אבר put a paste on her (for improving her complexion) limb-wise; Sabb. 80ᵇ.—Trnsf. (with שקרא) to charge falsely, calumniate (cmp. טוּחַ I, v.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 1:1">Targ. Y. I Deut. I, 1</cite>.

senses.gloss: to be put on. Part. מִיטַּפַּל, מִיטַּפְלָא, מִטַּ׳ (not מְ׳) forming a scab (h. מִסְפַּחַת).
units: Targ. Y. Lev. XIII, 6; 7; 8; 19.—2) to attend, care. Y. Taan. IV, 68ᵈ top עד דהוון מִיטַּפְּלִין ביה while they were engaged in burying him.—3) to join, attach one’s self.
<cite ref="Ketubot 23a:17">Keth. 23ᵃ</cite> <he>אִיטְּפֵל בקריבותיך</he> marry one of thy relations.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 26a">Snh. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ בהדיהו</he> joined them. Y. Kil. IX, 32ᶜ bot.; Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵇ <he>אזל וא׳ בהון מן תמן</he> (not <cite ref="G00536"><he>זמן</he></cite>) he went and remained in their company from thence.
